cards.meaning: a Ḥanafī primer giving an overview of Islamic law

cards.front: How is مُخْتَصَر القُدُورِي described in terms of scope?
cards.back: Extremely comprehensive — an overview of the whole of Islamic law

cards.meaning: the Prophet’s ﷺ way of life — how he did things, his advice, his teachings
the historical report — the container that preserves the Sunnah

cards.text: The {{c1::سُنَّة}} is the Prophet’s ﷺ way itself; the {{c2::حَدِيث}} is the container that preserves it

cards.front: What are the two sources of the entire Sharīʿah?
cards.back: The Qurʾān and the Ḥadīth — both of which are revelation

cards.meaning: the revelation that is recited — the Qurʾān
the revelation that is not recited — the Ḥadīth

cards.text: The Qurʾān is {{c1::الوَحْي المَتْلُوّ::recited}}; the Ḥadīth is {{c2::الوَحْي غَيْر المَتْلُوّ::not recited}}

cards.front: Why is the Ḥadīth counted as revelation at all?
cards.back: Because the Prophet ﷺ does not speak from his own whims — what he says is divinely inspired

cards.front: How is content divided between the Qurʾān and the Sunnah?
cards.back: The Qurʾān gives the general principles; the details come from the Prophet ﷺ

cards.front: What follows for anyone trying to act on the Qurʾān alone?
cards.back: It is impossible to understand, act upon, or follow the Qurʾān’s guidance without the Prophet ﷺ

cards.front: Who preserved the Ḥadīth, and in parallel with what?
cards.back: The scholars, through their efforts — just as the Qurʾān was preserved

cards.meaning: to clarify — one of the primary jobs of the Prophet ﷺ

cards.front: What is the Sunnah’s role with respect to the Qurʾān’s meaning?
cards.back: It is the detailed explanation of the Qurʾān — the Prophet’s ﷺ job of تَبْيِين

cards.front: What distinguishes the Prophet’s ﷺ miracle from those of every other prophet?
cards.back: Every prophet was given a miracle limited to his own lifetime; the Prophet ﷺ was given the Qurʾān, which is everlasting

cards.front: On what Qurʾānic grounds is following the Sunnah obligatory?
cards.back: Obeying the Messenger ﷺ is made equivalent to obeying Allah

cards.front: Complete: “It is not for a believing man or woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, …”
cards.back: …to differ — and those who disobey Allah and His Messenger have fallen into clear error

cards.front: Complete: “Whatever he ﷺ gives you, …; and whatever he forbids you from, …”
cards.back: …take it; …leave it

cards.front: Complete, to those who claim to love Allah: “If you love Allah, …; Allah will …”
cards.back: …closely follow me; …love you and forgive you

cards.front: Complete the ḥadīth: “Hold on firmly to …”
cards.back: …my Sunnah and the Sunnah of the rightly-guided Khulafāʾ

cards.front: Complete the ḥadīth: “The best speech is …, and the best guidance is …”
cards.back: …the Book of Allah; …the guidance of the Prophet ﷺ

cards.meaning: a beautiful example — the Qurʾān’s description of the Prophet ﷺ

cards.front: What does it mean that the Prophet ﷺ is an أُسْوَة حَسَنَة?
cards.back: His life is a practical demonstration of the teachings being preached — a physical manifestation of the Qurʾān’s guidance

cards.front: Complete the Qurʾānic address to the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed, you are upon …”
cards.back: …an exalted standard of character

cards.front: What are the three reasons given for the Sunnah’s significance?
cards.back:
1) It explains the Qurʾān
2) Following it is obligatory
3) He ﷺ is our role model

cards.front: How is the claim that the ḥadīth are unreliable or unnecessary characterised?
cards.back: As divorced from reality and from the religion; the one who makes it is a jāhil

cards.meaning: a personal ḥadīth collection kept by a Companion

cards.front: How early did the effort to preserve the Sunnah begin?
cards.back: From the very beginning — major Companions kept their own صَحِيفَة

cards.front: What was the pattern of ḥadīth preservation across the generations?
cards.back: Every generation contributed to it

cards.front: Which century is the golden age of ḥadīth studies?
cards.back: The 200s — the 3rd century AH

cards.front: What was compiled during the golden age of ḥadīth studies?
cards.back: The الكُتُب السِّتَّة — the Six Books

cards.front: Name the six compilers of الكُتُب السِّتَّة. (B, M, T, AD, IM, N)
cards.back: البُخَارِي، مُسْلِم، التِّرْمِذِي، أَبُو دَاوُد، ابْن مَاجَه، النَّسَائِي

cards.front: What is the relationship of later ḥadīth collections to الكُتُب السِّتَّة?
cards.back: Pretty much every collection after them traces back to these six

cards.front: Complete the ḥadīth: “Whoever preserves forty ḥadīth …”
cards.back: …will be resurrected among the scholars

cards.front: What is the grading of the ḥadīth about preserving forty narrations?
cards.back: Weak

cards.front: How did the scholars respond to the ḥadīth about preserving forty narrations, despite its grading?
cards.back: They still strove to act upon it

cards.front: How many narrations does the Arbaʿīn actually contain?
What do the narrations of the Arbaʿīn have in common?
cards.back: Each summarises a foundational principle of Islam; every one is among the foundations of the Dīn

cards.front: What is the full name of Imām al-Nawawī?
cards.back: أَبُو زَكَرِيَّا يَحْيَى بْن شَرَف النَّوَوِي

cards.front: What is Imām al-Nawawī’s title, and what does it mean?
cards.back: مُحْيِي الدِّين — the one who gives life to the religion

cards.front: What is Imām al-Nawawī’s كُنْيَة?
cards.back: أَبُو زَكَرِيَّا

cards.front: What is notable about Imām al-Nawawī’s كُنْيَة?
cards.back: He was never married and had no children

cards.front: What does the nisbah “al-Nawawī” refer to?
cards.back: نَوَا — the region in present-day Syria where he was born

cards.front: When was Imām al-Nawawī born?
cards.back: 631 AH

cards.front: When did Imām al-Nawawī die?
cards.back: 676 AH

cards.front: How long did Imām al-Nawawī live?
cards.back: Approximately 45 years

cards.front: Where did Imām al-Nawawī die, and on what date?
cards.back: In نَوَا, on the 24th of Rajab

cards.front: Which madhhab did Imām al-Nawawī follow?
cards.back: Shāfiʿī

cards.front: In which three fields was Imām al-Nawawī a specialist?
cards.back: Ḥadīth, Shāfiʿī fiqh, and uṣūl al-fiqh

cards.front: Which two works of Imām al-Nawawī are found in nearly every Muslim community?
cards.back: رِيَاض الصَّالِحِين and الأَرْبَعُون

cards.front: Of which major ḥadīth collection did Imām al-Nawawī write the well-known explanation?
cards.back: صَحِيح مُسْلِم

cards.front: What is المَجْمُوع?
cards.back: Imām al-Nawawī’s work on Shāfiʿī and comparative fiqh

cards.front: What is الأَذْكَار?
cards.back: Imām al-Nawawī’s compilation of duʿās and adhkār

cards.front: What is التِّبْيَان فِي آدَاب حَمَلَة القُرْآن about?
cards.back: The manners of the people of the Qurʾān

cards.front: What is بُسْتَان العَارِفِين — its meaning and its subject?
cards.back: “The garden of those who know” — a work on taṣawwuf and tazkiyah

cards.front: At what age, and to where, did Imām al-Nawawī go to study?
cards.back: At 19, his father took him to Damascus

cards.front: Where in Damascus did Imām al-Nawawī study?
cards.back: دَار الحَدِيث

cards.front: Where did Imām al-Nawawī live while studying in Damascus?
cards.back: In a small room at المَدْرَسَة الرَّوَاحِيَّة

cards.front: What did Imām al-Nawawī love deeply from a very young age?
cards.back: The Qurʾān

cards.front: What is related about Imām al-Nawawī’s sleep?
cards.back: He would sleep with his head on his books, and return to studying as soon as he woke

cards.front: How is Imām al-Nawawī’s writing style described?
cards.back: Easy to read — clarity of expression, conciseness, and comprehensiveness

cards.meaning: praise expressed verbally, given whether or not a favour has been received
thanks given specifically in response to a favour received

cards.text: Occasion. حَمْد may be given {{c1::whether or not a favour was done — including for an inherent quality}}; شُكْر is always {{c2::in response to a favour}}
Instrument. حَمْد is always {{c1::with the tongue}}; شُكْر can be {{c2::with the tongue, the heart, or the limbs}}

cards.front: What two things does حَمْد combine?
cards.back: Thanks and praise

cards.front: What is Imām al-Nawawī's standing within his madhhab?
cards.back: He is an authority within it
